description: Evidence-calibrated diagnostic rubric based on nine Ozon brand-lift campaign rows. It supports pre-test diagnostics and does not predict causal uplift.

criteria.name: brand_prominence_and_legibility
criteria.description: Upper-funnel: is the brand immediately visible, readable and bound to the product rather than merely present? Higher means stronger brand salience.

criteria.name: category_problem_clarity
criteria.description: Upper- and lower-funnel: can a viewer quickly identify the category, need state or problem being addressed?

criteria.name: single_minded_message
criteria.description: Recall: does the creative communicate one dominant proposition without competing headlines or benefit overload?

criteria.name: message_visual_binding
criteria.description: Recall: do headline, packshot, imagery and visual hierarchy reinforce the same idea so the message can be remembered with the brand?

criteria.name: specific_benefit_and_reason_to_buy
criteria.description: Purchase intent: is the benefit concrete, differentiated and directly relevant rather than generic language such as only 'energy' or 'benefit'?

criteria.name: product_proof_and_trust
criteria.description: Purchase intent: are packshot, product cues, credible evidence and claim qualification sufficient to support the promise without overclaiming?

criteria.name: audience_context_relevance
criteria.description: Does the message fit the audience's current context, season, life stage, pain and purchase situation?

criteria.name: distinctiveness_and_memory_hook
criteria.description: Awareness/recall: is there a distinctive device beyond category colors, packshot and a standard discount badge?

criteria.name: conversion_cue
criteria.description: Purchase intent: is there a clear next action and offer, and is it supported by a reason to act rather than relying on discount/CTA alone?

criteria.name: cognitive_load_and_hierarchy
criteria.description: Can the viewer decode brand, problem, benefit, product and CTA in the intended order at placement size? Higher means lower cognitive load and stronger hierarchy.

criteria.name: negative_reaction_resilience
criteria.description: Higher is better: low risk of confusion, distrust, backlash, inappropriate tone or claim concerns. Do not score raw risk in the opposite direction.

criteria.name: funnel_coherence
criteria.description: Does the creative connect attention and brand salience to a credible reason to consider or buy, rather than excelling at only one funnel stage?

calibration_reference.method: descriptive creative audit + approximate two-proportion z-tests + BH-FDR
constraints: No causal attribution to an individual banner when multiple assets or placements are linked.
No training claim from nine campaign rows.
